description: Get the recent chat history between the user and an app's AI agent.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 20)

name: vibekit_agent_history

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Array of recent chat messages between the user and the app's agent.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Agent History
